fields.description: Default header title copy 0: Shift-JIS for 'Rabu Hina' (Love Hina). First 8-byte EEPROM unit of the 24-byte ROM-default header.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006958 copies 0x20 bytes from ROM default (DAT_080069ec) into local buffer and writes EEPROM addresses 0-4 via FUN_0800c1fc/FUN_0800c0c0; address 0 covers logical save offsets 0x00-0x07. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x00-0x07 decode as Shift-JIS 'Rabu Hina'.
fields.name: header_title_copy_0

fields.description: Default header title copy 1: Shift-JIS for 'Rabu Hina'. Second 8-byte EEPROM unit of the header.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006958 writes EEPROM address 1 via FUN_0800c1fc/FUN_0800c0c0 covering logical save offsets 0x08-0x0F. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x08-0x0F are byte-identical to copy 0 and decode as Shift-JIS 'Rabu Hina'.
fields.name: header_title_copy_1

fields.description: Default header title copy 2: Shift-JIS for 'Rabu Hina'. Third 8-byte EEPROM unit of the header.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006958 writes EEPROM address 2 via FUN_0800c1fc/FUN_0800c0c0 covering logical save offsets 0x10-0x17. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x10-0x17 are byte-identical to copies 0/1 and decode as Shift-JIS 'Rabu Hina'.
fields.name: header_title_copy_2

fields.description: Save magic trailer 'save0001' terminating the 32-byte ROM-default header.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006958 writes EEPROM address 3 via FUN_0800c1fc/FUN_0800c0c0 covering logical save offsets 0x18-0x1F. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x18-0x1F read exactly 'save0001'.
fields.name: save_magic_save0001

fields.description: Live gameplay/config state word: 4 bytes serializeled little-endian from the RAM word behind DAT_08006bd4 into EEPROM block 4. Zero in a fresh (baseline) save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006b48 loads the 4-byte RAM value *DAT_08006bd4 and stores it little-endian into buffer bytes 0x20-0x23, then commits the 8-byte unit to EEPROM address 4 via FUN_0800c1fc/FUN_0800c0c0 (logical save offsets 0x20-0x27). Baseline rev8-logical value is 0.
fields.name: save_data_word32

fields.description: Live gameplay/config state half-word: 2 bytes serialized little-endian from the RAM value behind DAT_08006bd8 into EEPROM block 4. Zero in a fresh (baseline) save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006b48 loads the 2-byte RAM value *DAT_08006bd8 and stores it little-endian into buffer bytes 0x24-0x25, then commits the 8-byte unit to EEPROM address 4 via FUN_0800c1fc/FUN_0800c0c0 (logical save offsets 0x20-0x27). Baseline rev8-logical value is 0.
fields.name: save_data_half16

fields.description: Reserved tail of EEPROM block 4: written as zeros by the format path and left untouched by the live-update path.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006958 zero-pads the local buffer through 0x28 and writes EEPROM address 4 (logical offsets 0x20-0x27) via FUN_0800c1fc; FUN_08006b48 only fills buffer bytes 0x20-0x25 before rewriting the same address. Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x26-0x27 are zero.
fields.name: block4_reserved

fields.description: Zero guard block terminating the 48-byte save record; format path writes zeros here.
fields.evidence: FUN_08006958 second loop writes 8 zero bytes via FUN_0800c1fc starting at EEPROM address 5, covering logical save offsets 0x28-0x2F (with further zero guards at 0x58, 0x88, 0xB8, 0xE8, 0x118, 0x148, 0x178, 0x1A8). Baseline rev8-logical bytes 0x28-0x2F are zero.
fields.name: record_zero_guard

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'save0001' header trailer at logical offset 0x18

title: Love Hina Advance - Shukufuku no Kane wa Naru Kana (Japan)
